name: Precision Wire Technologies

about:
Precision Wire Technologies operates from Fort Wayne, Indiana, where it has been drawing fine and ultra-fine wire for nearly 30 years. The company began as a specialist in fine wire drawing and has since expanded into resistance wire manufacturing and custom drawing services. No founding year or ownership structure is disclosed in public materials.

The company produces wire in diameters ranging from 0.0011 inch (49 gauge) to 0.102 inch (10 gauge) across a broad alloy portfolio that includes Nichrome, nickel-iron, nickel-copper, bronze, stainless steel, brass, Monel, iron-chrome-aluminum, nickel-chrome, nickel-plated steel, and pure nickel. Services encompass fine wire drawing, resistance wire manufacturing, straight-and-cut wire in lengths from 1 to 144 inches, and custom drawing projects for difficult specifications. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

Precision Wire Technologies does not explicitly list target industries or customer types on its website. Its alloy wire and custom drawing capabilities suggest applications in electronics, aerospace, medical devices, and industrial heating, but no specific sectors or named clients are provided in the available information.

The company emphasizes tight tolerances and short lead times as key differentiators, along with customized stocking strategies and a willingness to take on drawing projects that other suppliers decline. Its central U.S. location and relationships with multiple alloy suppliers are cited as advantages for material availability and delivery speed.
